claim_guard: This redesign follows inspection of the completed eight-target benchmark. It can compare prespecified transfer objects on the retained development panel, but it cannot create independent confirmation. The final selected implementation must be frozen on an outcome-unseen temporal, external, or prospective target.
scientific_hypothesis: Neighbor knowledge improves OOD prediction when the transferred object matches the recipient mechanism or endpoint, multiple complementary source modules are retained, and a target-only fallback can suppress negative transfer.

development_objective.tail: CVaR of the worst 25 percent group squared errors
development_objective.rank: pairwise ranking loss for prespecified rank-only contracts
development_objective.negative_transfer_guard: penalty and zero-allocation check for wrong, shuffled and random experts

primary_evaluation.cohort_rule: At least two independent programme clusters pass the complete gate and the programme-bootstrap lower interval for mean Q4 gain is positive.
primary_evaluation.cross_database_rule: At least one cross-database edge must pass before making a cross-database OOD prediction claim.

implementation_stages.local_smoke: complete: three grouped draws and three fixed learners; polymer tensile mechanism bundle is the sole escalation signal
implementation_stages.balam_development: 100 grouped draws; nested pseudo-OOD tuning; three learners; 5000 bootstraps; 9999 sign flips
implementation_stages.independent_confirmation: one completely outcome-unseen temporal, external, or prospective target

quick_smoke.interpretation: Screening signal only; no intervals, multiplicity correction, nested bundle selection or independent confirmation.
